find_connected_digits: run a script to find and list all connected DIGIT devices using digit.find()
connect_digit_device: create a Digit instance with a serial number and friendly name then call connect()
set_rgb_intensity: set the RGB LED intensity on a Digit device using set_intensity_rgb with r, g, b values
get_digit_frame: get a camera frame from a connected Digit device using get_frame and display with cv2
set_uniform_intensity: set all LEDs on a Digit device to the same intensity value using set_intensity
